WHY THIS COULD MATTER

A testable response to a documented repair gap

Australia's Productivity Commission found significant and unnecessary barriers to repair for some products and identified restricted access to repair information among them. Australia's environment department reports 511,000 tonnes of e-waste were created in 2019.

Documented problemRepair information can be restrictedDemonstrated hereA sourced, portable evidence handoverStill to measureRepeat work, repair success and waste avoided

CONTROLLED RETRIEVAL CHECK

Structure preserved more of the case

Across 28 blind-format reads by two local model families, the same seven fictional cases yielded 133/140 correct fields and zero critical errors from FixProof handovers, versus 127/140 and two critical errors from ordinary transcripts.
